candidates.description: This vector is related to the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (sɔ̄ sɯ̌a) and its common syllabic combinations or contextual character fragments.
This feature vector represents common English and Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical subword tokens.
This feature vector represents common word endings and linguistic suffixes across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to biochemical and molecular biology terminology, particularly chemical prefixes and scientific roots.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the Thai consonant 'บ' (Bo Baimai) and the Latin letter 'B/b'.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letters 'am' or their Thai script equivalents.
This vector represents names, proper nouns, and specific character sequences across multiple languages including English, Thai, and others.

This vector activates for common subwords and morphemes found across various non-English and multilingual scripts, particularly European and Southeast Asian languages.
